offers_products.reason: Manufactures electric heat tracing cables, heaters, boilers, tubing bundles and power distribution panels.

offers_services.reason: Also provides engineering, installation, maintenance and field services for heat tracing projects, though products are the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells industrial heating systems to process industries, not to households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are oil and gas, chemical, power, and transportation companies and EPC contractors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue mostly comes from project-based capital orders, with some maintenance and repeat orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Heating systems for capital projects and new facilities in energy and chemicals can be deferred in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Engineered heat tracing systems and boilers are project-sized, infrequent purchases, though maintenance parts are smaller.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for manufactured heating products and engineered systems, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large energy, chemical and industrial enterprises and large EPC contractors.

asset_heavy.reason: Light-to-moderate manufacturing of cables and heaters; no fleets, networks or property-heavy operations.

notes: Business mix inferred from the website text and general knowledge. Products are the larger part, with services secondary.
